text:
ashley: quick follow-up after the overnight flap — we still saw ~60 pages in 2h, mostly duplicates + one noisy p95 alert. want owners + simple acceptance criteria so we can close the postmortem loop.

ben: i'll own the dedupe key change and the short suppression config. plan: group by `service:job:region:tier:error_code`, suppression 25s, rolling window 10m. ETA: Thu EOD.

carla: i'll take the alert queries. current rule trig: `avg_over_time(latency[1m]) > 0.9`. propose: p95 over 5m with `for: 3m` and add a `rate()` smoothing on error count to avoid noisy tails. ETA: next Tue.

diego: paging policy note: we should not wake oncall for a single region unless customer-impact label is set. suggestion: escalate only if >=2 regions OR pages > 3 in 15m. also add a 15m per-responder backoff. i'll update the policy doc and PD mapping. ETA: Fri morning.

emma: i'll update runbooks + add a post-deploy evaluation checklist. Acceptance criteria for merges: (1) replay shows pages drop >=30% on noisy alerts, (2) customer_error_rate doesn't increase >3%, (3) staging canary runs 24h. ETA: Mon AM.

ben: sample dedupe snippet i'll include in PR:
```
group_key: "{{service}}:{{job}}:{{region}}:{{tier}}:{{code}}"
suppression: 25s
window: 10m
```
will also add unit tests.

carla: draft PromQL (will bench on historical traffic):
```
# p95 latency per job/region/tier over 5m
expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, region, tier)) > 1.0
for: 3m
```
this should ignore single-request spikes.

diego: small caution: don't aggregate across `tier` 1 (free/prod). if we remove tier we'll hide prod-only regressions.

ben: agreed, will keep tier in key.

emma: canary plan: route 20% of traffic to tuned alerts for 24h, collect pages_per_min, unique_incidents, mttack, and customer_error_rate. rollback if pages_per_min_canary > control by 25% AND customer_error_rate delta < 4%.

ashley: good. owners recap (confirm):
- Dedupe key + suppression: ben 1 ETA Thu EOD
- PromQL & replay eval: carla 1 ETA Tue next week
- Paging policy + PD mapping: diego 1 ETA Fri AM
- Runbook + acceptance criteria: emma 1 ETA Mon AM

ben: confirmed. i'll open a draft PR and add examples.

carla: confirmed. i'll post replay snapshots here once done.

emma: confirmed. will draft acceptance doc and runbook changes.

oncall-bot: Calendar event created: "Alert noise mitigation sync" Wed 14:30 UTC 1 attendees: #eng-oncall. Reminder 20m prior.

ashley: thanks all. please drop PR links, replay dashboards, and staging screenshots here. we'll sign off after canary + checklist pass. :white_check_mark:
